units.source_text: 东山如意岳的“大字”虽是正统，其实是在五座山上焚的火。

en.t: Although the “Dai” character on Higashiyama’s Nyoigatake is the orthodox one, it is actually one of the fires burned on five mountains.

units.source_text: 除了如意岳大字外，还有金阁寺附近大北山的“左大字”、松崎山的“妙法”、

en.t: Besides the Dai character on Nyoigatake, there are also the “Left Dai” on Okita-yama near Kinkakuji, and the “Myoho” on Matsugasaki-yama,

units.source_text: 西贺茂明见山的“船形”、上嵯峨山的“牌坊形”，

en.t: the “Boat” shape on Nishigamo’s Myoken-yama, and the “Torii” shape on Kami-Saga-yama,

units.source_text: 这五座山相继焚起火来。

en.t: and fires are lit one after another on these five mountains.

units.source_text: 在约莫四十分钟的焚火时间里，市内的霓虹灯、广告灯都一齐熄灭。

en.t: During the roughly forty minutes of the ceremonial bonfires, the neon signs and advertising lights throughout the city are all turned off at once.
